intro: Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen serves as the trauma surgeon and chief physician of Alliance Trauma in Theramore Isle. Stationed within Foothold Citadel, he trains the island's healers and evaluates medics who wish to master the highest tiers of field triage and bandage work.

p: Located on the ground floor of Foothold Citadel in Theramore Isle, Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen oversees the medical care of Lady Jaina Proudmoore's forces and trains the outpost's frontline healers. Facing harsh conditions in Dustwallow Marsh, VanHowzen insists on rigorous field competence, personally putting experienced medics through an intense triage test to ensure they can prioritize critical wounds under severe pressure.
